{
  "category_edits": [
    {
      "category": "network_architecture",
      "rationale": "Add a jointly trained residual bottleneck adapter after each GRU timestep: h + W_up GELU(W_down h). Its width is max(8, hidden_units // 4), and zero-initialized output weights preserve the initial GRU mapping. Keep the existing embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Persist the adapter width and load the same architecture through the predictor writer.",
      "edits": [
        {
          "find": "    def __init__(self, itemnum: int, hidden_units: int = 128, num_layers: int = 1,
                 dropout_rate: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.itemnum = itemnum
        self.hidden_units = hidden_units
        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        dropout = dropout_rate if num_layers > 1 else 0.0
        self.gru = nn.GRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                          batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)",
          "replace": "    def __init__(self, itemnum: int, hidden_units: int = 128, num_layers: int = 1,
                 dropout_rate: float = 0.1, adapter_width: int | None = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.itemnum = itemnum
        self.hidden_units = hidden_units
        self.item_emb = nn.Embedding(itemnum + 1, hidden_units, padding_idx=0)
        dropout = dropout_rate if num_layers > 1 else 0.0
        self.gru = nn.GRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                          batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
        self.adapter_width = max(8, hidden_units // 4) if adapter_width is None else adapter_width
        self.adapter = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_units, self.adapter_width),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(self.adapter_width, hidden_units),
        )
        nn.init.zeros_(self.adapter[-1].weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.adapter[-1].bias)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)"
        },
        {
          "find": "        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        # Histories are LEFT padded; count-1 indexes padding on short histories.",
          "replace": "        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + self.adapter(out)
        # Histories are LEFT padded; count-1 indexes padding on short histories."
        },
        {
          "find": "        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        pos_scores = (out * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)",
          "replace": "        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + self.adapter(out)
        pos_scores = (out * self.item_emb(pos)).sum(dim=-1)"
        },
        {
          "find": "            "num_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
            "dropout_rate": DROPOUT_RATE,",
          "replace": "            "num_layers": NUM_LAYERS,
            "dropout_rate": DROPOUT_RATE,
            "adapter_width": model.adapter_width,"
        },
        {
          "find": "            num_layers=meta["num_layers"],
            dropout_rate=0.0,",
          "replace": "            num_layers=meta["num_layers"],
            dropout_rate=0.0,
            adapter_width=meta["adapter_width"],"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "change_summary": "Add a zero-initialized residual bottleneck adapter to the GRU outputs, with matching checkpoint metadata and predictor construction. Retain one model per category and the existing training configuration."
}
